lee: PixelSilicon confirmed they can run the preflight bench next week but asked for an NDA redline and confirmed shipping windows. Can someone own the bench script + perf keys? @sanjay?
sanjay: I can own the harness. Which config do we want—seq len, batch, quantization profile?
claire: Legal flagged that PixelSilicon wants the right to share internal results. They asked for a mutual embargo instead of a strict prohibition. Can we offer a 2-week embargo for joint blog? :thinking_face: 
darin: Heads up: marketplace listing needs a SKU, perf tags (p95 latency, thpt tokens/s), and a partner container image. @lee can you confirm artifact access and registry creds?
megan: Shipping note — partner prefers FedEx Priority overnight. Our lab can only accept Mon–Wed. I can schedule Tue pickup if they can ship Mon. Need device serials and OS preload instructions.
rachel-pixelsilicon: Thanks — we can share the image after NDA. For our hardware we usually run `--threads=32 --seq=4096` for stress. FYI we've seen thermal throttling at sustained 4k sequences; may need a soak plan.
sanjay: Thermal throttling is a big risk for our comparison numbers. Plan: 3x short cold runs (warm cache off) + 1x 30m soak with telemetry on. Collect GPU_POWER, T_CORE, GPU_FREQ, memory_bandwidth. I'll publish a run command and parsers.

sanjay: Example run (will be in repo):
```
./run_bench.sh \
  --model redwood/fast-7b \
  --seq 4096 \
  --batch 1 \
  --quant int8 \
  --threads 32 \
  --collect-metrics gpu_power,gpu_temp,gpu_freq,mem_bw \
  --synthetic-prompts true
```
lee: I'll ping Legal and Ops now. Proposed embargo date 2024-11-12. Does that work for PM/Marketing? :calendar: 
claire: 11/12 is fine but PM wants a canary internal note 1 week after embargo, and Marketing needs the joint announcement checklist (press contacts, quotes, assets).
darin: Telemetry/privacy: we can't accept PII. Tests must use synthetic prompts only; the harness will scrub tokens and return aggregated perf counters + anonymized flamegraphs. Will add a data handling doc to the repo.
rachel-pixelsilicon: We agree to synthetic prompts and aggregated metrics. Uploading NDA redline now: https://files.pixelsil.com/nda-redline-1733.pdf. We'll attach the container image to a temporary s3 bucket once NDA is signed.
lee: Action items: 
- sanjay: bench harness + perf keys + example parsers by Fri (1734500000)
- megan: arrange shipping label and coordinate lab arrival (Mon/Tue window)
- claire: follow up with Legal on redline and confirm mutual embargo wording
- darin: marketplace SKU template + required artifact list
- rachel-pixelsilicon: confirm image upload and NDA ack
I'll send a calendar invite for the kickoff call and include the checklist. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
